title.en: The Extra Rural Diesel Concrete Pump Photograph Still Orders the Same Printed Row
title.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的另一张照片仍然对应同一行已印参数

description.en: The extra rural diesel photograph still orders the printed 17 kW, 800 kg row at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. It does not add a second weight or a price. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
description.zh: 农村柴油泵的另一张照片仍然对应 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump 上已印的 17 kW、800 kg 这一行。它不另加重量，也不印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

h1.en: A Second Photograph Does Not Open a Second Rural Diesel Concrete Pump Row
h1.zh: 第二张照片不会变成农村自建房柴油混凝土泵的第二行参数

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. This photograph is a separate factory picture of the same listed model. It does not print a second weight, a second output or a price. Copy the cells that page prints: Model Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; Diesel Engine Power 17 kW; Theoretical Output 5–8 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m; Vertical Delivery Height 10–30 m; Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm; Hopper Capacity 0.2 m³; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; Total Weight 800 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and Total Weight 800 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.2 m³. Theoretical output is printed as 5–8 m³/h. Send mix or material, maximum aggregate, the output you need, horizontal and vertical distance, diesel or the site voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing. The price is not on the page. Confirm the price with Xingtai at /contact. A related note in this set is /blog/buy-electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump-unused-photo-inquiry.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把农村自建房柴油混凝土泵列在 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。 这张照片是同一已列型号的另一张工厂图片。它不另印重量、不另印输送量，也不印价格。抄该页已印的格子：型号 Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump、柴油机功率 17 kW、理论输送量 5–8 m³/h、泵送压力 15 MPa、水平输送距离 30–50 m、垂直输送高度 10–30 m、最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm、料斗容积 0.2 m³、外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm、整机重量 800 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm，以及整机重量 800 kg。料斗容积是 0.2 m³。理论输送量印的是 5–8 m³/h。同时发送材料或配合比、最大骨料、需要的输送量、水平与垂直距离、柴油或现场电压和频率、国家与采购时间。页面上没有价格。价格向邢台询盘确认，用 /contact。本批相关说明见 /blog/buy-electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump-unused-photo-inquiry。

heading.en: What to copy from this page

body.en: Name /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump in the subject line. The published row is: Model Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump; Diesel Engine Power 17 kW; Theoretical Output 5–8 m³/h; Pumping Pressure 15 MPa; Horizontal Delivery Distance 30–50 m; Vertical Delivery Height 10–30 m; Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm; Hopper Capacity 0.2 m³; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm; Total Weight 800 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and Total Weight 800 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。已公布的一行是：型号 Rural Self-Built House Diesel Pump、柴油机功率 17 kW、理论输送量 5–8 m³/h、泵送压力 15 MPa、水平输送距离 30–50 m、垂直输送高度 10–30 m、最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm、料斗容积 0.2 m³、外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm、整机重量 800 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm，以及整机重量 800 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Power and line size on the same note
heading.zh: 同一封里的动力和管路

body.en: The power cell on this page is diesel, printed as 17 kW. Write diesel on the inquiry. Do not replace it with an electric-motor figure from another page. This page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Leave that cell blank on the order and confirm the size with Xingtai if the job needs pipe.
body.zh: 这一页的动力格是柴油，印的是 17 kW。询盘写柴油。不要改成另一页上的电机数字。这一页没有印输送管径。订单上这一格留空；如果工程要配管子，向邢台确认尺寸。

body.en: Confirm the price with Xingtai. The page does not print a list price, a production-day count, a certificate name or a list of export countries. Equipment on these pages ships from Xingtai. The category answers do not claim an overseas warehouse. Write to /contact, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Another page in this set is /blog/buy-factory-hero-still-needs-a-model-path.
body.zh: 价格向邢台询盘确认。页面不印标价、不印生产天数、不印证书名称，也不印出口国名单。这些页面上的设备从邢台发货。分类说明不声称有海外仓。写信到 /contact、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。本批另一篇是 /blog/buy-factory-hero-still-needs-a-model-path。

answer.en: It is not printed on the Rural Diesel Concrete Pump page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 农村自建房柴油混凝土泵页面上没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Which address do I put on the inquiry?

answer.en: Put /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. That path selects this row. The contact page is /contact.
answer.zh: 写上 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。这条路径选定这一行。联系页是 /contact。

question.en: What weight do I give the forwarder?

answer.en: For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm and Total Weight 800 kg.
answer.zh: 运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm，以及整机重量 800 kg。

question.en: Can I add a certificate or a delivery date?
question.zh: 可以补上证书或交货日期吗？

answer.en: The page does not print a certificate name or a production-day count. Ask Xingtai in the same inquiry, and do not fill those cells yourself.
answer.zh: 页面没有印证书名称，也没有印生产天数。在同一封询盘里问邢台，不要自己填这些格子。

question.en: Which hopper volume is on this row?
question.zh: 这一行的料斗容积是多少？

answer.en: The page prints 0.2 m³. Use that figure with /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump.
answer.zh: 页面印的是 0.2 m³。与 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump 一起使用这个数字。
